question: Padma Shri Pandit Rajeev Tharanath, the famous ____________ player is from the state of Karnataka.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**sarod**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri Pandit Rajeev Tharanath** is a renowned **sarod player** from the state of **Karnataka**.
 
• He is celebrated as one of the finest **Hindustani classical musicians** in India.
 
• Pandit Rajeev Tharanath is a disciple of the legendary **Ustad Ali Akbar Khan**, who was one of the greatest sarod maestros.
 
• He has been honored with the **Padma Shri Award** for his significant contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• The **sarod** is a stringed instrument widely used in Indian classical music and is known for its deep and resonant sound.
 
• Pandit Rajeev Tharanath has performed globally, showcasing his mastery over the sarod and contributing to the spread of Indian classical music on the international stage.
 
• In addition to being a musician, he has also been a **teacher**, passing on his knowledge to the next generation of artists.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Flute**__

 __
 
• The **flute** is a wind instrument commonly used in Indian classical music, particularly in the **Carnatic and Hindustani traditions**.
 
• One of the most famous Indian flutists is **Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia**.
 
• The flute's soothing and melodious sound makes it a distinctive instrument in Indian music.
 
 
 
• **Violin**__
 __
 
• The **violin** is a string instrument that plays a significant role in **Carnatic music**, the classical music tradition of South India.
 
• It was introduced to Indian classical music during the colonial era and has since been adapted to suit Indian styles.
 
• Renowned violinists include **Lalgudi Jayaraman** and **Dr. L. Subramaniam**.
 
 
 
• **Sitar**__
 
 
• The **sitar** is one of the most iconic instruments of Indian classical music.
 
• It gained global recognition through musicians like **Pandit Ravi Shankar**.
 
• The sitar is known for its unique tonal quality and is often used in both Hindustani classical music and fusion music.
